elements.requirement: Section 86 of the Equality Act 2010 applies for the purposes of section 27 in its application to section 85(4) or (5).
elements.quote: applies for the purposes of section 27 in its application to section 85(4) or (5)

elements.requirement: References to B in section 27(1)(a) and (b) include a reference to a parent or sibling of the child in question.
elements.quote: The references to B in paragraphs (a) and (b) of subsection (1) of section 27 include a reference to a parent or sibling of the child in question

elements.requirement: Giving false evidence or information, or making a false allegation, in good faith is not a protected act where the evidence or information is given, or the allegation is made, by a parent or sibling of the child, and the child has acted in bad faith.
elements.quote: Giving false evidence or information, or making a false allegation, in good faith is not a protected act in a case where— (a) the evidence or information is given, or the allegation is made, by a parent or sibling of the child, and (b) the child has acted in bad faith

elements.requirement: Giving false evidence or information, or making a false allegation, in bad faith, is a protected act where the evidence or information is given, or the allegation is made, by a parent or sibling of the child, and the child has acted in good faith.
elements.quote: Giving false evidence or information, or making a false allegation, in bad faith, is a protected act in a case where— (a) the evidence or information is given, or the allegation is made, by a parent or sibling of the child, and (b) the child has acted in good faith

elements.requirement: A child is defined as a person who has not attained the age of 18.
elements.quote: “child” means a person who has not attained the age of 18

elements.requirement: A sibling is defined as a brother or sister, a half-brother or half-sister, or a stepbrother or stepsister.
elements.quote: “sibling” means a brother or sister, a half-brother or half-sister, or a stepbrother or stepsister

thresholds.what: the maximum age below which a person is defined as a child
thresholds.quote: has not attained the age of 18
